tool.name: AddWalkImpedanceColumn
tool.summary: Calculate a walk_impedance cost multiplier for each segment feature based on its road class and subtype. Values below 1.0 indicate pedestrian-friendly segments (e.g. footways, pedestrian streets); values above 1.0 penalise segments less suitable for walking (e.g. motorways, primary roads). A value of -1 marks segments where walking is prohibited (e.g. water, rail).

usage.bullet_item: The input features must contain class and subtype text fields, typically present on Overture segment features.
The tool adds a walk_impedance float field. The value is used as a multiplier on segment length when computing walk routing costs.
Segments whose class and subtype do not match any rule receive a default impedance of 1.0 (neutral cost).

param.name: input_features
param.dialogReference: The segment feature layer or feature class to which the walk_impedance field will be added.
